title: Special Topics in Agricultural and Resources Economics
description: This course provides students with an advanced undergraduate understanding of key aspects of agricultural trade and the impact of domestic agricultural policies and international-trade policies on the agricultural sector. Students will study the gains (losses) from trade, the effect of quantitative (import quotas, export quotas), tax (tariffs and export taxes) policies, non-tariff barriers to trade, domestic subsidization and supply controls on the agricultural sector. Particular emphasis will be given to the US agricultural sector.
